terms.p: A type whose values are exactly one of a listed set of shapes, so the number of possible values is the sum of the alternatives rather than the product of a set of fields.
One of the named alternatives an enum value can be, together with whatever data that alternative carries.
The small hidden number stored inside an enum value that says which variant it currently is.
The compiler using a bit pattern the payload can never hold, such as a null pointer, to stand for a variant, so the enum needs no separate tag and takes no extra space.
Whether the names introduced by a pattern take the matched data itself or a reference to it, which the compiler chooses based on whether you matched on a value or on a reference.
The rule that matching a reference against an ordinary pattern quietly borrows instead of failing, so every name the pattern binds comes out as a reference and nothing is moved.
An extra condition written after a pattern that must also be true for the arm to be chosen, and which the exhaustiveness check deliberately ignores.
Several patterns joined with a vertical bar so one arm handles all of them, which requires every alternative to bind the same names at the same types.
A design where a value is in exactly one of a fixed set of states and changes between them only through a function that maps an old state and an event to a new state.
Describing a match that handles every value the scrutinee could possibly be, which the compiler checks and refuses to compile without.
